verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the instruction to use "tax preparation approved software" to submit Form CT-5. That implies the department runs an approved-software e-file channel software can submit through. Everything else in the pack describes human-facing Online Services, Web File and Quick Pay, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: documentation of the system-to-system channel itself (transmitter/e-file provider or batch program specs), system or service accounts, a published enrollment or approval path for software developers and transmitters, and independent corroboration.
